create_tracker_initialize: initialize a TensorBoardTracker to log training metrics and hyperparameters to TensorBoard
build_tracker_wandb: build a WandBTracker to log metrics, images, and tables to Weights & Biases
test_tracker_filter: test the filter_trackers function to validate available loggers and filter unsupported types
run_tracker_log: run a GeneralTracker log method to store key-value metric pairs with optional step numbers
summarize_tracker_finish: summarize the GeneralTracker.finish method to close and finalize all tracking sessions
